THE BALL-GUARD ELECTION EXCLUDES THE CANDIDATE'S OWN +24, AND A HUMAN-OWNED MANIFESTATION CARRIES THE HUMAN'S +24. sub_15340 (VA 0x15340 = CARPET.EXE file 0x2db38) opens its class-3 chain walk with a test against the CANDIDATE, not the wizard -- VERIFIED in the shipped bytes at 0x2db58: `8b 54 24 14` mov 0x14(esp),edx (a1 = the candidate being scored), `66 8b 43 18` mov 0x18(ebx),ax (the chain node's +24), `66 3b 42 18` cmp 0x18(edx),ax, `74 2b` je -> SKIP. A SECOND test at 0x2db66 then excludes the wizard's own +24. So any class-3 chain member sharing the candidate's id is barred from guarding it. On an ordinary mana ball +24 is the ball's own slot and the test never fires -- but the tick-top ball chain is walked LIVE, so a slot can be recycled before a rival brain reaches it, and sub_15080 reads that record raw. A human-cast BALLOON stamps +24 with the CASTER's carpet id, so retail drops the human from his own balloon's guard election and the balloon reads UNGUARDED however close he stands. The port seats the out-of-pool human OUTSIDE the chain walk, and that seat skipped the id test the loop applies to every pooled member -- so the human guarded his own balloon, the claim was refused, the rival dropped out of the ball arm entirely and fell through to the mana hunt onto creature 43 with 5,000 mana. Rival-owned balloons were never affected: their casters are pooled and the loop already excluded them. This is the human's out-of-pool asymmetry again (cf. round 103, THE PLAYER IS JUST ANOTHER POOL RECORD). WITNESS mc1l48 pair 23212->23213: the human mints balloon 249 over his castle; retail's Adhab (712) claims it (+146 690 -> 249, +148 1068 = 681 + 3 + (3<<7), the sub_15420 signature verified at 0x2dc18 as movsbw class64<<7 + movsbw model65 + +24); slot 712 f146 retail 249 port 43 was the ONLY diverging lane on the record. mc1l48 598 seg/51 devs -> 597/50, and ZERO chase rows remain anywhere in mc1l48's head map.
